newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-ASTROS SIGN FIRST-ROUND PICK LANCE BERKMAN.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-ASTROS SIGN FIRST-ROUND PICK LANCE BERKMAN.

text.p: The Houston Astros have come to terms on an undisclosed contract with first baseman Lance Berkman, their first-round pick in the June amateur draft, the team said Friday.

The 21-year-old Berkman, a switch-hitter, was the 16th pick of the draft. At nearby Rice University, Berkman launched 41 homers and drove in 134 runs this season -- totals that led the nation and set school and Western Athletic Conference records -- while hitting .431.
He added 110 hits and scored 109 runs, becoming the only player besides Florida State's Jeff Ledbetter (1982) to reach triple digits in RBI, hits and runs in the same season.
